tagline: I build practical software — web backends, mobile apps, data tools and desktop applications — that solve real problems.
description: Portfolio of Abdulfatai Ibn Zachariya, a Python & Backend Developer building web apps, Android apps, data tools and desktop software.
about: I'm a Python developer who came into software from Analytical Chemistry (MTech, Federal University of Technology, Minna). Lab work taught me to be methodical, to trust data, and to keep digging until a problem is actually solved — habits I bring to every codebase.

Today I build backends with Flask, FastAPI and PostgreSQL, web frontends with React, native Android apps with Kotlin, and data tools with Pandas. I've built and launched Cliqo, a marketplace for trusted service providers; Cliqo Health, a low-cost remote-consultation platform; and CliqoCheck, an Android app with in-app payments. I'm also prototyping CheckAm, a tool to help NAFDAC fight fake products. Before that, I worked on SiteLedger, a fuel and asset operations platform built by a multi-team capstone through the NCDMB Digitalization Initiative (NDI), across both the backend and the frontend.

I'm also a CAPM-certified project manager, hold an International Executive Certificate in Safety Management, and trained as a graphic designer — so I'm comfortable planning work, thinking about risk, and caring about how things look.
